instruction: Put the camera on the table and do not touch it
Pick it up: SLOWLY tilt up and down (nod)
SLOWLY turn left and right (shake head)
Put it down on the table - do not touch
Pick it up: tilt up/down FAST
Put it down - do not touch
Move forward/back WITHOUT rotating (keep it pointing the same way)
Put it down - do not touch
Walk around the room holding it like a UMI gripper (normal use)
Put it down - do not touch
Mixed fast motion: rotate and move quickly in all directions
Put it back on the table in the same spot and do not touch it
